claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no magic_item kind. types.ts exports SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord only. A MagicItemRecord with at least one mechanics family (e.g. 'activated_item') is required before any magic item can be encoded.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing this amulet, you can take a Magic action to name a location...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: attunement_slot resource in surface types
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: v4 atom inventory lists 'attunement_slot' as a resource atom. No surface type currently models it. Magic items that require attunement must express consumption of an attunement slot.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ability_check resolution in item activation context
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's activation branches on a DC 15 Intelligence (Arcana) check. v4 has 'ability_check' as a resolution atom, but no surface ActivationPhase or item-mechanics type supports it. SpellMechanics has save_gate and attack_roll phases; neither is an ability check.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: transport_exile with random table destination
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: On a failed check, the effect transports creatures to a destination determined by 1d100 → conditional sub-rolls (1d6, 1d8). v4 has 'transport_exile' as an effect atom but no surface type models random-table destination selection. The randomness is nested (1d100 picks a range, then a second die picks a specific plane within that range). No existing DiceAmount or Effect shape captures this.
